sinopsis.en: Adrian (42) and Emma (38), two divorced parents, meet for the first time in fifteen years to honor the memory of Malena, their only daughter. Before she died, Malena wrote her parents a travel journal, which they must follow together, in each other's company. The trip will not only be a light that allows them to cope with their pain, but also an opportunity to listen to each other and forgive one another. To reconnect.
